scope: All 40 prompts, ordered options, explanations and all option reasons compared with Japanese source; not a native-speaker review.

food-1-q297.notes: 180～220ppm and measured 160ppm preserved; lower-bound failure, immediate report and prohibition on concealing the difference preserved.

food-1-q376.notes: 80℃ minimum and actual 79℃ preserved; report actual result and deviation without changing the measured value.

food-1-q324.notes: Cashew, 2026 edition and instruction to check the edition instead of applying old item counts preserved.

food-1-q122.notes: Long hair must be gathered and covered with no hair protruding; incorrect options and their negations retained.

food-1-q244.notes: Milk-use dedicated spatula contaminating a non-milk product, allergen transfer and reporting duty preserved; freezing or metal detection does not resolve contamination.

food-1-q089.notes: Rinse soap thoroughly under running water before clean drying; gloves do not replace rinsing.

food-1-q342.notes: Broken thermometer, interrupted measurement, reporting and procedural recording preserved; attempted measurement does not justify inventing a confirmed value.

food-1-q273.notes: Sharing near misses supports collective cause/prevention analysis and factory improvement, including events without injury; no blame framing introduced.
